responsibility: This file implements the diagnostic-context helper used by GCC selftests. In checking builds it defines test_diagnostic_context so tests can initialize a deterministic diagnostic_context with carets, labels, columns, and a custom span callback that rewrites filenames to a fixed placeholder, making diagnostic output stable and comparable in unit tests. Its responsibility is selftest support infrastructure for diagnostics, not diagnostics or tests themselves.
same_name_distinction: Implements the selftest::test_diagnostic_context behavior, including diagnostic_initialize/finish and the filename-sanitizing start_span callback used to make diagnostic output deterministic; the header only declares this checking-build helper class.
